runs.latest_final: The man was a passenger in a hot-air balloon that was losing altitude over the desert. To lighten it, the people aboard threw out several suitcases. They then used matchsticks to draw lots to decide who among them would jump out; the man drew the short half-matchstick, meaning he was the one required to leave. He did not jump voluntarily, so the other occupants forced or threw him out of the balloon. He fell from the balloon into the desert and died on impact, still clutching the half matchstick that had marked him as the chosen sacrifice.
